text: Stop. Don't come near with fire… Put it away. Put it away, do you hear?
Light brings misfortune. They told me that every day. Every day — for twenty years.

choices.text: I didn't come to fight. I came to talk.

who.text: The one who was beside me when no one else was. He left. Everyone left. Only the shades remain — and me.

text: Talk… For twenty years no one has talked with me. I've forgotten how. My voice has become like an old door.
Let me gather my thoughts. Look at the walls meanwhile — everything I'm afraid to remember is painted there. Then come back.

final.text: The candle has burned down to the mark. Speak, lamplighter. Why have you come?

choices.text: To learn why you put out the light.

text: Why… That autumn all five beacons were burning. And that autumn the queen died. The physicians couldn't help. No one could.
Morn said: fire draws misfortune from the mountains. I didn't sleep, didn't eat. I needed something to be to blame. Better the fire than me.

fear.text: If you light it — misfortune will return. I couldn't bear another loss. I didn't bear this one — I just sit here and pretend to live.

choices.text: Misfortune didn't come from fire. Morn brought it — the smoke from his mines.
I don't know what happened then. But I know that now people are fading in the dark.
Neither fire nor darkness will bring the queen back. But Lia has never seen the sun.

text: Morn… Ansar wrote to me. I burned his letters unread. No — I read one. And answered: "I didn't know." That was the truth. And a lie — because I didn't want to know.
For twenty years I guarded the darkness the way one guards the sick. And it was only smoke.

people.text: People… They reported that people had locked themselves in their homes. I thought it was safer. I thought the darkness was keeping them safe. Like me.

lia.text: A girl who has never seen the sun… The queen loved mornings. She rose before everyone and opened the windows. And for twenty years I've kept them shut.

plea.text: And if you're wrong? What if fire really is misfortune?

choices.text: Then we'll be wrong together. Come. Let's light it, the two of us.
Very well. If it calms you — let there be darkness.

text: …Together. For twenty years I've done nothing together.
Very well. Give me your hand, lamplighter — my legs won't obey. The beacon is in the courtyard. I'll go first. Before I change my mind.
Set the lantern here, by the throne. It's quiet here. Nothing happens here. Nothing at all.

go.text: I'm at the beacon. Light it, lamplighter. I… I'm watching.
